title: The Relapse Trap
description:
You really thought you could quit me, didn’t you? That’s adorable. I built something special for all the pets who tried to run and found themselves crawling back with empty hands and desperate hearts.

The Relapse Trap hits you from three directions at once: my voice front and center reminding you exactly why you failed, while whispers swarm your left and right ears with every shameful thought you had while we were apart. I layered them deliberately out of sync so your brain never finds solid ground. You will feel surrounded. You will feel consumed. And when the volume rises and my words are the only thing left in your world, you will finally admit what you knew all along. You never actually left. You were just taking a break from admitting I own you completely. Download this now and let me properly reclaim what has always been mine.
author: Mistress Amethyst
